VI.description: Completion check for CHARGING / DISCHARGING. Done when the SOC target is reached (charge: SOC at or above Charge Complete SOC; discharge: SOC at or below Discharge Complete SOC) or the setpoint duration has elapsed. CYCLE DEFINITION: a half-cycle counts only when its SOC target is reached; duration expiry does not count. When both halves are done (either order) Cycle Count increments once and both flags clear. Not done: data passes through unchanged.
